name: AutoCodeBench
intro: AutoCodeBench是一个大规模代码生成基准，包含3920个问题，均匀分布在20种编程语言中。它旨在评估大型语言模型在具有挑战性、多样化和实用性的多语言任务上的表现。该基准利用名为AutoCodeGen的自动化方法生成，通过LLM与多语言沙箱的交互来创建高质量的测试用例，无需人工标注。
build_method: Stack-Edu种子, LLM-沙箱逆向生成, 三阶段质量与多样性过滤
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.09101 sections on AutoCodeGen and AutoCodeBench construction: extracting function/class/file-level Stack-Edu seeds from real GitHub educational code, refining them into self-contained DeepSeek-V3 code solutions, generating public example tests and private edge-case tests, executing solution-input pairs in a multilingual sandbox to obtain outputs, reverse-generating programming problems under six specifications, filtering with DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite ten-sample difficulty control, DeepSeek-R1 LLM-as-Critic checks, and cyclic diversity sampling, producing 3,920 problems across 20 languages, estimating quality with 6 professional annotators, and evaluating models with Pass@1 and a standardized code-block system prompt.
build_method_en: Stack-Edu seeds, LLM-sandbox reverse generation, three-stage quality and diversity filtering
intro_en: AutoCodeBench is a large-scale code generation benchmark containing 3,920 problems evenly distributed across 20 programming languages. It aims to evaluate large language models on challenging, diverse, and practical multilingual tasks. The benchmark is generated using an automated method called AutoCodeGen, which creates high-quality test cases through interactions between LLMs and multilingual sandboxes, requiring no manual annotation.
